name: Forgotten Pool
summary: The Forgotten Pool is a submerged cavern tucked deep beneath the flooded corridors of Blackfathom Deeps. Located beyond the Moonshrine Ruins, this quiet dead-end serves as the aquatic lair of monstrous deep-sea predators lurking in the subterranean dark.

sections.title: A Submerged Lair
sections.body: Reaching the Forgotten Pool requires diving into the sunken subterranean waterways extending past the Moonshrine Ruins. Cut off from dry ground, the pool is an isolated, stagnant cavern completely flooded by dark waters. Away from the chanting Twilight's Hammer cultists and the patrolling naga, this secluded pocket serves as the lair of the ancient aquatic terror known as Old Serra'kis, keeping the beast hidden in the flooded dark.

faq.q: Where is the Forgotten Pool located?
faq.answer: The Forgotten Pool is an entirely submerged underwater cavern situated deep within Blackfathom Deeps. To reach it, explorers must swim through the flooded tunnels branching off past the Moonshrine Ruins.

faq.q: What lurks inside the Forgotten Pool?
faq.answer: The cavern serves as the hidden lair of Old Serra'kis, an ancient thresher-like beast of the deep waters that makes the secluded dead-end its lair.

faq.q: Does the Forgotten Pool lead anywhere else?
aliases: is forgotten pool a dead end
faq.answer: No. The pool is an underwater dead-end with no further passageways, serving strictly as a secluded aquatic nest.

angles.text: Horde scouts venturing into Blackfathom Deeps may find Old Serra'kis lurking in the flooded dark of the pool, far from the cult's chanting halls.
